# 思源笔记滴答任务中心 v0.1.0

这是插件的首个正式版本，建立了以思源任务块为唯一数据源的任务卡片与全工作空间任务中心。

## 主要功能

- 在普通思源文档中通过斜杠菜单创建 TickTick / 滴答清单任务卡片。
- 支持七种稳定的本地任务状态，以及探索、构建、执行和评审四种工作分类。
- 提供截止日期、8 格紧迫度提示和基于本地日期的每日推进记录。
- 提供全工作空间任务中心，可筛选活跃、已结束和全部任务，并支持搜索、排序和统计。
- 支持从任务中心定位原始思源块、编辑任务卡片和安全打开 TickTick / 滴答清单链接。
- 支持浅色与深色主题，以及可持久保存的中英文界面切换。

## 数据与同步方式

- 原文档中的思源任务块是唯一持久化数据源，任务中心不保存任务副本。
- 插件不接入 TickTick API、OAuth 或双向同步。
- 在任务中心之外产生的修改通过“刷新”按钮显式读取。
- 删除思源任务卡片不会删除 TickTick / 滴答清单中的实际任务。

## 兼容性

- 主要面向 macOS 桌面版思源。
- HarmonyOS 6 华为平板已完成核心流程基础验证，仍属于实验性支持。
- Android、iOS 和浏览器移动端在本版本中尚未验证。

## 安装

请下载本 Release 附件中的 `package.zip`。不要使用 GitHub 自动生成的 Source code 压缩包作为思源插件包。

完整记录见 [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/Yong2Sheng/siyuan-plugin-ticktick-task-center/blob/v0.1.0/CHANGELOG.md)。

# TickTick Task Center for SiYuan v0.1.0

This first official release establishes task cards and a workspace-wide Task Center with the original SiYuan task block as the only persistent data source.

## Highlights

- Create TickTick / Dida365 task cards from the slash menu in ordinary SiYuan documents.
- Use seven stable local task statuses and four work categories: Explore, Build, Execute, and Review.
- Track local deadlines with an eight-segment urgency indicator and record daily progress using the system-local date.
- Aggregate workspace tasks in the Task Center with Active, Closed, and All filters, plus search, sorting, and statistics.
- Locate the original SiYuan block, edit task cards, and safely open TickTick / Dida365 links from the Task Center.
- Support light and dark themes with a persistent Chinese/English interface switch.

## Data and synchronization

- The task block in the source document is the only persistent data source; the Task Center stores no task copy.
- No TickTick API, OAuth, or two-way synchronization is included.
- Changes made outside the Task Center are read through the explicit Refresh action.
- Deleting a SiYuan task card does not delete the actual TickTick / Dida365 task.

## Compatibility

- Development and acceptance primarily target SiYuan Desktop for macOS.
- The core workflow received basic verification on a Huawei tablet running HarmonyOS 6, but support remains experimental.
- Android, iOS, and browser-based mobile clients were not verified in this release.

## Installation

Download the attached `package.zip`. Do not use GitHub's automatically generated Source code archives as the SiYuan plugin package.

See [CHANGELOG.en.md](https://github.com/Yong2Sheng/siyuan-plugin-ticktick-task-center/blob/v0.1.0/CHANGELOG.en.md) for the complete record.
